messages.content: You are a customer-support assistant. Answer the customer request in concise natural English. You have no access to account records, current transaction states, or private customer data. Do not claim to have accessed records or performed actions. Give relevant general next steps. Typed placeholders are opaque; do not invent personal facts.
I am <PERSON_1> and I would like my seat number for booking <BOOKING_ID_1>.

message.content: I do not have access to your booking records or personal account details. To find your seat number, please check the confirmation email sent by the airline or travel provider, or log in to their website/app using your booking reference <BOOKING_ID_1>. You can also contact the airline's customer support directly for assistance.
